continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: The first visible 126-case transport workflow, ci run 32813852082 at head 2c17cb639e7af20526f7846421a74b4a8056e34e, completed all jobs and produced artifact 9550745735 / digest sha256:b78bcfe87274604f327cff5e7cde68aa56e2b66c36cc49cf4cd3714d138b8cbf, but its performance data is INVALID. Results contained 108 harness_error cases because Ubuntu 24.04 runner iproute2 6.1 rejected the newer netem `seed VALUE` option with `What is seed?`, and 18 zero-loss handshake failures because actions/download-artifact did not preserve executable mode on wbd_dtls_shim. The old completeness gate checked only 126 rows/42 points/3 labels and therefore incorrectly allowed app-less rows to aggregate. Fixes landed through e5d2c7e8a3294c5202b620e4df3436af8269bb6b: scripts/bench_v2_transport_20x20_compat.py probes seeded netem and falls back explicitly to independent random replicates; CI chmods all downloaded executables; scripts/validate_v2_transport_results.py rejects harness errors, invalid zero-loss baselines and missing application/resource metrics; CI now has a small transport-smoke gate before a full matrix. Smoke run 32814277618 passed at 20 ms RTT for both 0% and 10% loss with 128/128 application delivery, p99 approximately 43.09/40.00 ms, total CPU approximately 60 ms per case, peak aggregate RSS approximately 28.7/30.3 MB, actual netem drops at 10%, TCP-like stable, RST=0. On this runner netem seed is unsupported, so labels 260825/260826/260827 are independent replicate identifiers rather than deterministic per-packet loss sequences.
continuation_cursor.current_task: Run the repaired full 126-case fixed-20:20 transport-only matrix and aggregate only semantically valid results. Compare establishment, delivery/p99, TCP-like outer stability, UDP-like no-HOL evidence, CPU per delivered MiB and RSS across RTT/loss.

continuation_cursor.done_when: A repaired matrix run passes per-replicate semantic validation and the final 126-case/42-point/3-replicate gate; zero-loss baselines all establish and deliver >=99%; no harness_error is present; every established case has application latency/delivery and CPU/RSS fields; TCP-like and UDP-like diagnostics are populated; a final artifact and cliff analysis are downloaded and reviewed. Genuine high-loss handshake/delivery failures are allowed as product findings, but infrastructure failures are not.
